note: All unverified; estimates never count as savings.

candidates.title: Revere: hand off to a fresh session before the coordinator grows
candidates.proposed_test: Run one Y1 build phase with handoffs at a 200k-token cap against the audited X1 coordinator; unit completed_phase; measure get_session cost per phase and checker pass.

estimate_unverified.basis: simulated: main context held under 200k with a 20k handoff, net of handoff cost; mean of 4 complete session(s); tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Avoid idle cache rebuilds: resume from a short handoff after waiting
candidates.proposed_test: Before an expected idle longer than 5 minutes write a handoff and resume in a short context; compare the first resumed call's cache write with an audited rebuild; unit resumed_wait.

estimate_unverified.basis: simulated: idle rebuild rewrites a short handoff context instead; mean of 2 complete session(s); tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Watchman: monitor pull requests and CI outside the big session
candidates.proposed_test: Run the next pull-request babysit to merge with a scripted CI watcher that wakes the main session only on change, against the audited PR 31/33 session; unit pr_babysit_to_merge.

estimate_unverified.basis: simulated: status checks run in a 50k context, last check kept; mean of 2 complete session(s); tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Quiet protocol: scripts print twenty lines or fewer
candidates.proposed_test: Run the next agent batch with scripts printing at most 20 lines and files read by range; re-audit against the audited X1 batch; unit accepted_claim.

estimate_unverified.basis: assumed: print cap removes 25% of tool-output cost (top-25 causes only); mean of 4 complete session(s), 1 partial excluded; tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Quiet protocol: cap replies and move long reasoning into files
candidates.proposed_test: Run the next agent batch with replies capped at a few lines and reports written to files; re-audit against the audited X1 batch; unit accepted_claim.

estimate_unverified.basis: assumed: reply cap removes 50% of narration cost; mean of 4 complete session(s); tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Spare setup: shrink the fixed per-agent setup read on every call
candidates.proposed_test: Start one empty session per configuration (connectors off, shorter rules) and read each first-call context in tokens; unit empty_session_first_call.

estimate_unverified.basis: simulated: 10k tokens off each agent's setup on every call; mean of 4 complete session(s); tokens are input-price cost units; overlaps other savers; unmeasured

candidates.title: Sentinel: check inputs and paths before long scripts run
candidates.proposed_test: Same job with a preflight step (paths, tools, network, schema); measure failed calls and usd per unit.

estimate_unverified.basis: upper bound: friction cost attributed in 5 audited sessions, divided by 5; assumes the saver removes all of it; tokens are input-price cost units; an incomplete session counts only its saved part

candidates.title: Quiet protocol: cap tool output before it enters context
candidates.proposed_test: Same agent batch with and without an output cap; measure oversize errors, tool_output cost and usd per unit.

estimate_unverified.basis: upper bound: friction cost attributed in 5 audited sessions, divided by 5; assumes the saver removes all of it; tokens are input-price cost units; an incomplete session counts only its saved part

candidates.title: Letter of Marque: pre-approve safe commands, no blocked waits
candidates.proposed_test: Same task twice, once with an allowlist and Monitor-style waits; measure denials and usd per accepted unit.

estimate_unverified.basis: upper bound: friction cost attributed in 5 audited sessions, divided by 5; assumes the saver removes all of it; tokens are input-price cost units; an incomplete session counts only its saved part

candidates.title: Mason-Dixon: one owner per branch, fetch and rebase before push
candidates.proposed_test: Two parallel-agent runs on one task, with and without the branch rule; measure conflicts and usd per merged PR.

estimate_unverified.basis: upper bound: friction cost attributed in 5 audited sessions, divided by 5; assumes the saver removes all of it; tokens are input-price cost units; an incomplete session counts only its saved part

candidates.title: Customs House: screen rows for sources before full production
candidates.proposed_test: Same batch with a cheap source-availability screen before the producer runs; measure rows blocked after full work and usd per accepted unit.
